source: One key: its value in every locale with file and line (and its translation {0} and {1} when the file records them), locales where it is missing, usages in code with a few lines of context, and diagnostics. Check a key with it before creating or renaming one.
text: 获取单个键：它在每种语言中的值及所在文件和行号（如果文件记录了翻译的 {0} 和 {1}，也会一并返回）、缺失该键的语言、代码中的引用（附带几行上下文）以及诊断。在创建或重命名键之前，请先用它检查该键。
